sections.what_happened: Two men (24, British national; 25, dual British-Iranian) were rearrested under National Security Act Section 3 — assisting a foreign intelligence service — in the investigation of the September plot against RAF Fairford (US B-1 base). First arrested Sept 27 and Oct 1, previously bailed; 5 others remain on bail. Police: 'highly likely that there is Iranian state involvement.' PM Burnham: the plot was 'almost certainly' directed by the IRGC. Iran denies. Police found petrol in three vans, no explosives; US pulled bombers from Fairford.
sections.what_verified: CNN, AP, SCMP, Arab News, Al Jazeera, 1news.nz all carry the police statement with matching details.
sections.what_disputed: Iran firmly rejects the accusations; no charges filed yet; the 'IRGC-directed' framing is the PM's/police's assessment, not adjudicated fact.
sections.why_matters: Upgrade from monitor: the Fairford plot now has National Security Act rearrests — the Iran-war front inside Britain, stated carefully as police allegation, not verdict.
